about: The method of record: the ONE recipe per kind of step that a film or still is ordered with, and whether it is settled. Nothing else in the repo says how a step is ordered: the store (tools/order-store.ts), Bordet and the production list (tools/produce.ts) take every default from here through src/order-methods.ts recipeFor, and a draft that departs from it is a deliberate exception. A recipe: model, resolution, seconds (the film's length where no reference film goes with it; with one the film is as long as the reference), takes, the text's style and template (the version of src/order-prompts.ts the recipe is written for; template 11 writes the deal by the hand at the shoe in the words of template 10, which the trials tried, word for word; the register stops reading when the template is counted up, so that a recipe is looked at again), turn (plan: what Placering says per card, or a turn of src/order-model.ts), hand (LH: the hand at the shoe takes the card and lays it, as every trial that held; plan: what Placering says per card; null: the step has no hand to say, or its own, as the two hands of anchor 2.3; a handbyte is never a recipe, since it fell in both its trials, and is ordered only as an exception), shape (a deal: ONE_WAY bara dit, ROUND_TRIP tur och retur), reference (ingen; samma-plats-rakt-godkänd: a film of the bank of the same step to the same seat that Jakob approved straight; renderad-eller-samma-plats: the 3D lane's dummy film for the seat first, data/rendered-references.json; renderad: only the dummy's film; where the rule finds no film the step waits and nothing is ordered), lastPicture (ankare: the anchor the film ends on; ritat-kort: the first picture with the card drawn where the plan lays it; platsens-slutbild: the seat's own end picture, its landing picture where one holds, else the cut frame of the bank's film to the seat) and extra (Jakob's addition). status gäller: ordered without further trial, two takes per clip; prov: still being tried, one change and one take per trial (the recipe here is the next trial); saknas: no method yet, so the step has no default at all. seats narrows a deal to a class of seats where the evidence differs: mitten P3-P5, ytter P1, P2, P6, P7, dealer D.C1 and D.C2. Evidence: order ids, the independent reviewer's scores (the protocol, node tools/order-ledger.ts) and Jakob's own words quoted from motions/<id>.json (review.userReview). Methods are the same for every dealer; the evidence is Paow's. Change a status only on evidence, and say who and when.
